_about: Crop disease risk for ABF Field Shift. APPROXIMATE thresholds from general plant-pathology guidance, not calibrated for Tajikistan: confirm with a local agronomist. Weather = NASA POWER daily T2M (°C), RH2M (%), PRECTOTCORR (mm/day) for the last 30 days at the field centre. A 'favourable day' has a mean temperature inside temp[] and relative humidity at or above rhMin (rhMin 0 = temperature only). Points: favourable days >= daysHigh → 2, >= daysMedium → 1; 30-day rain >= rainMm → +1 (rainMm null = rain not needed); current month in months[] → +1, otherwise −1. Level: points >= levels.high → HIGH, >= levels.medium → MEDIUM, else LOW. Names and tips shown in the app come from the locale files (dis.<id>.name / dis.<id>.tip); the English here is for reference.
note: approximate, confirm with a local agronomist

yellow_rust.name: Yellow (stripe) rust
yellow_rust.tip: Grow resistant varieties and check leaves weekly in spring for yellow stripes.

septoria.name: Septoria leaf blotch
septoria.tip: Do not sow wheat after wheat; bury or remove infected straw.

net_blotch.name: Net blotch
net_blotch.tip: Use clean seed and rotate with a non-cereal crop.

powdery_mildew.name: Powdery mildew
powdery_mildew.tip: Avoid too much nitrogen fertiliser and too dense sowing.

leaf_blight.name: Northern leaf blight
leaf_blight.tip: Plough in old maize stalks and rotate with a legume.

common_rust.name: Common rust
common_rust.tip: Choose resistant hybrids and sow early.

late_blight.name: Late blight
late_blight.tip: Water the soil, not the leaves; remove sick plants at once.

early_blight.name: Early blight
early_blight.tip: Remove lower spotted leaves and keep plants well fed.

onion_downy.name: Downy mildew
onion_downy.tip: Plant in sunny, airy rows and avoid evening watering.

purple_blotch.name: Purple blotch
purple_blotch.tip: Keep rows wide and remove old onion leaves after harvest.

ascochyta.name: Ascochyta blight
ascochyta.tip: Sow healthy seed and keep 3 years between legume crops on one field.

fusarium_wilt.name: Fusarium wilt
fusarium_wilt.tip: Use wilt-resistant varieties and rotate for several years.

lentil_rust.name: Lentil rust
lentil_rust.tip: Sow early and use resistant varieties.

alfalfa_downy.name: Downy mildew
alfalfa_downy.tip: Cut early when you see pale leaves; the next growth is usually clean.

leaf_spot.name: Common leaf spot
leaf_spot.tip: Cut on time so fallen sick leaves do not pile up.

verticillium.name: Verticillium wilt
verticillium.tip: Rotate with wheat or alfalfa and avoid too much watering.

alternaria.name: Alternaria leaf spot
alternaria.tip: Give balanced fertiliser (enough potassium) and avoid water stress.

brown_rot.name: Brown rot (Monilinia)
brown_rot.tip: Remove mummified fruit and dead twigs; prune for open crowns.

shot_hole.name: Shot hole
shot_hole.tip: Cut out spotted shoots and spray copper after leaf fall.
